reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides agent-facing tools for searching public GitHub repositories and reading repository releases, metadata, and tags through the GitHub REST API.

summaries.zh: 通过 GitHub 公开 REST API 为 agent 提供仓库搜索、仓库概览、Release 和 Git 标签查询工具。
summaries.en: Provides agent-facing tools to search public GitHub repositories and inspect repository metadata, releases, and Git tags through the GitHub REST API.

capabilities: Read public GitHub repository metadata through the GitHub REST API
Search public repositories using GitHub search syntax
List public repository releases and Git tags
Optionally use a configured GitHub token for higher request limits
